title: 129 Rescue Wing Provides Tropical Storm Kay Support
description: A pair of search and rescue teams with the 129th Rescue Wing traveled to Joint Forces Training Base, Los Alamitos, California in two HH-60G Pave Hawk helicopters ready to assist during Tropical Storm Kay Sept. 11, 2022. Pararescue specialists are trained to conduct rooftop, mountainside and vehicle rescue operations during a flood event. (U.S. Air National Guard video by A1C Kevin Nious)
keywords: 129th Rescue Wing, Tropical Storm Kay, search and rescue
